_metadata.source: Sprint 1 seed extract from the SAP Cloudification Repository — focused on the SD/MM/FI scope used by DarkHorse's current test cases (backorder, finance open items, PO validation).

levelLegend.A: Released cloud-ready API/view — public, stable, target of all new development
levelLegend.B: Released for on-premise S/4HANA — acceptable for Private Cloud / on-prem deployments
levelLegend.C: Not released — classic SAP object, prohibited for new development; must use Level A/B alternative
levelLegend.D: Deprecated / non-existent / explicitly forbidden by Clean Core guidance

objects.reasoning: Direct table access bypasses SAP-managed extensions, currency conversions, and authorization checks. Use the released CDS view instead.
